title: Dev Club: Learn ESP32
description: Build a Simon Says game on an ESP32. Learn breadboards, C with Arduino IDE, GPIO, OLED displays, and MQTT. Winner gets a free t-shirt.

title: ClawCon Michigan
description: Open, social-first gathering from the OpenClaw community. Live demos of personal AI tools, Q&A, and time to meet fellow builders.

title: Student Software Showcase
location: Floyd Hall D-212, Parkview Engineering Campus
description: Show off your projects and businesses at Dev Club's last event of the semester. Free Canes, lemonade, and cookies.

title: LINK: Art Night at KIA
description: Evening at the KIA with hands-on art activities, guided gallery tours, live music, food, and short talks from local voices in the Kalamazoo arts scene.

title: Kalamazoo Venture Tuesday
description: Free virtual pitch event hosted by the WMed Innovation Center. Three investors give live feedback to three presenting companies on what they did right and wrong.

title: April 5x5 Night
location: Start Garden Vault, 2 Fulton St W, Grand Rapids
description: Five Michigan innovators get five minutes each to pitch. One walks away with $5,000. Open pitch competition hosted by Start Garden.

title: Founders First Friday
location: Start Garden Vault, 2 Fulton St W, Grand Rapids
description: Agenda-free morning meetup for founders to connect, share challenges, and be resources for each other. Hosted by Start Garden on the first Friday of each month.

title: Cultivate269: The $100,000 Pitch Night
description: Pitch competition hosted by Kalamazoo Forward Ventures. Local founders compete for a share of $100,000 in front of investors.

title: Startup Zoo Pitch Night
description: Five finalists pitch their startups for $10,000 in equity-free capital. Audience favorite wins an additional $1,000. Hosted by Startup Zoo.

title: August 5x5 Night
location: Birch & Blossom, 112 E Main St, Hart
description: Five entrepreneurs get five minutes and five slides each to pitch a panel of judges and a live audience. One walks away with $5,000. Hosted by Start Garden with West Michigan economic development partners.

title: Bronco Bash
description: WMU's giant start-of-semester festival, 3 to 6 PM. Come find our table in Zone 0, Tables 11-13, to meet the team and see what we're building.

title: 1 Million Cups Kalamazoo
location: WMed Innovation Center, 4717 Campus Drive, Kalamazoo
description: Free monthly morning meetup where early-stage founders present their companies to a room of entrepreneurs, mentors, and advisers. Each presenter gets six minutes, then opens the floor for questions.

title: PitchMI Semifinal: Defense & Aerospace
description: Defense and aerospace semifinal of PitchMI, presented by the MSU Research Foundation and the MEDC. The winner takes $250,000 and advances to the statewide championship for another $1 million.

title: SW Michigan Summit: Pitch Night
location: Kalamazoo Institute of Arts, 314 S Park St, Kalamazoo
description: Five founders take the stage with five minutes each to pitch the judges. One goes home with $10,000. Opening night of the Southwest Michigan Entrepreneurship Summit, hosted by Startup Zoo.

title: SW Michigan Entrepreneurship Summit
location: Kalamazoo Institute of Arts, 314 S Park St, Kalamazoo
description: Over 100 founders and funders gather from 10 AM to 4 PM to dig into how tomorrow's Michigan companies get funded and built. Hosted by Startup Zoo.

title: PitchMI Semifinal: AI & Software
location: Kalamazoo Civic Theatre, 329 S Park St, Kalamazoo
description: AI and software semifinal of PitchMI, presented by the MSU Research Foundation and the MEDC. The winner takes $250,000 and advances to the statewide championship for another $1 million.

title: PitchMI Semifinal: Advanced Manufacturing, Materials & Outdoors
description: Advanced manufacturing, materials, and outdoors semifinal of PitchMI, presented by the MSU Research Foundation and the MEDC. The winner takes $250,000 and advances to the statewide championship for another $1 million.

title: PitchMI Semifinal: Healthcare & Life Sciences
